summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms. Lambda is appended to monai/transforms/utility/array.py and asserts func is callable. Lambdad is in monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py between ConcatItemsd and the alias block, subclasses MapTransform, and delegates to one internal Lambda. Aliases LambdaD and LambdaDict are added. The typing import now includes Callable, and Lambda is added to the array import list. Docs entries were added to docs/source/transforms.rst. Tests were added in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. The git diff removes only the original typing import line. Nothing was committed. Tests, flake8, and black were not run, per the instruction not to execute repository code, so lint and test results are unverified.
